tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List guide categories
tools.description: List all Red Dead Redemption 1 completion categories with official 100% counts, completionist extras, and dataset health.

tools.name: list_items
tools.title: List guide items
tools.description: List trackable entries in one Red Dead Redemption 1 category (story, strangers, bounties, collectibles, etc.), optionally filtered to official 100% items or a region.

officialOnly.description: When true, only entries required for official 100% completion.

region.description: Filter by region name, e.g. 'New Austin'.

tools.name: search_guide
tools.title: Search the guide
tools.description: Free-text search across every Red Dead Redemption 1 guide entry (titles, summaries, walkthroughs, tags) and return matching ids for get_walkthrough.

query.description: Search text, e.g. 'Evans Repeater' or 'treasure map'.

tools.name: get_walkthrough
tools.title: Get walkthrough
tools.description: Get the full walkthrough for one guide entry by id: objectives, step-by-step checklist, gold medal requirements, missable warnings, rewards, map marker details and unlock steps.

id.description: Trackable id, e.g. a mission or collectible id from list_items.

tools.name: list_map_pins
tools.title: List map pins
tools.description: List every guide entry that has a map pin on the Border States 1910 base map — rare weapons, treasure maps, hideouts and bounty locations — with normalized coordinates and captions.

category.description: Optional category id filter, e.g. 'weapons' or 'collectibles'.

verifiedOnly.description: When true, only pins with verified coordinates.
